site.title: Payments Radar
site.tagline: A daily sweep of what matters in payment fraud, payment engineering and retail commerce.

topics.label: Fraud & risk
topics.description: Account takeover, card testing, bots, identity verification, scams, chargebacks and disputes, network fraud programs, and fraud ML.

topics.label: Payment engineering
topics.description: Payment architecture, resilience, tokenization, authorization and retries, real-time payments, agentic-commerce protocols, and ML platforms for risk.

topics.label: Retail & commerce
topics.description: Grocery and big-box checkout, wallets and contactless, interchange and network rule changes, swipe-fee litigation, store pickup and self-checkout.
